# dc-zsn.3: ASC, DBCS and the byte functions under en-ZA (not a double-byte language): ASC and
# DBCS keep every width, and the byte functions count characters.

DBCS("Aa1")

DBCS(" ")
ASC(_xlfn.UNICHAR(12288))
DBCS("~\")
ASC(_xlfn.UNICHAR(65509))

DBCS(_xlfn.UNICHAR(44032))

DBCS("'")

LENB(_xlfn.UNICHAR(20013))
LENB(_xlfn.UNICHAR(65313))

RIGHTB("ab"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(20013),1)
FINDB("b",_xlfn.UNICHAR(20013)&"b")
SEARCHB("B",_xlfn.UNICHAR(20013)&"b")
REPLACEB(_xlfn.UNICHAR(20013)&"abc",2,1,"x")
